systemd-update-done.service: Records completion of local /etc and /var initialization; installs no software.
systemd-update-utmp.service: Records boot and shutdown in utmp; installs no software.
systemd-update-utmp-runlevel.service: Records runlevel changes in utmp; installs no software.
plocate-updatedb.service: Rebuilds the local filename search index; installs no software.
plocate-updatedb.timer: Schedules only the local filename search index.
nvidia-cdi-refresh.path: NVIDIA toolkit path watcher for regenerated CDI device descriptions; does not install/update drivers. Reviewed deployments/systemd in NVIDIA/nvidia-container-toolkit v1.20.1.
nvidia-cdi-refresh.service: Regenerates /run/cdi/nvidia.yaml and device nodes using the installed nvidia-ctk. Does not fetch drivers. Reviewed NVIDIA/nvidia-container-toolkit deployments/systemd/nvidia-cdi-refresh.service.
auditd.service: Security audit logging; the update matches are comments about unit overrides and ordering, not a software updater. Reviewed linux-audit/audit-userspace init.d/auditd.service.in.
authselect-apply-changes.service: authselect apply-changes --upgrade regenerates local authentication configuration from installed templates; no packages are installed. Reviewed authselect/authselect systemd/authselect-apply-changes.service.
fedora-atomic-desktop-mandb-update.servi: Rebuilds the local man-page search database; no software installation.
unbound-anchor.timer: Refreshes only DNSSEC root trust data, not software. Reviewed NLnet Labs unbound-anchor(8).
unbound-anchor.service: Refreshes only DNSSEC root trust data, not software. Reviewed NLnet Labs unbound-anchor(8).
xdg-user-dirs.service: Initializes localized directories in the user's home; installs no software. Reviewed freedesktop.org Software/xdg-user-dirs.
bootc-status-updated.path: bootc 1.16.13 watches /ostree/bootc mtime and triggers only its status notification target. No update command. Reviewed bootc-dev/bootc v1.16.13 systemd/bootc-status-updated.path and docs/src/man/bootc-status-updated.path.5.md.
bootc-status-updated-onboot.target: bootc 1.16.13 boot-time status/state notification target, no Exec command or software installation. Reviewed bootc-dev/bootc v1.16.13 systemd/bootc-status-updated-onboot.target and generator.rs.
bootc-status-updated.target: bootc 1.16.13 status-change notification target, no Exec command or software installation. Reviewed bootc-dev/bootc v1.16.13 systemd/bootc-status-updated.target.
bootc-publish-rhsm-facts.service: bootc 1.16.13 systemd/bootc-publish-rhsm-facts.service publishes local deployment facts to RHSM; no deployment or package mutation.
capsule@.service: systemd v259.9 units/capsule@.service.in starts a capsule user manager; upgrade appears in a reload comment. No software installation.
chrony-wait.service: chronyc waitsync waits for clock synchronization; no software update. Inherited unit's ordering/comment matches are not commands.
cups.service: cupsd -l is the print daemon; no software installation. Unit ordering/comments can mention upgrades.
grub-boot-indeterminate.service: grub2-editenv increments the local boot_indeterminate counter; it does not install a bootloader or software.
ldconfig.service: systemd v259.9 units/ldconfig.service runs ldconfig -X to refresh the installed-library cache; no package update.
man-db-cache-update.service: mandb rebuilds the installed manual-page index; no software installation.
man-db-restart-cache-update.service: Schedules only a rebuild of the installed manual-page index; no software installation.
nfs-utils.service: ExecStart=/bin/true groups NFS daemons for service restarts; no software installation.
plymouth-read-write.service: plymouth update-root-fs informs the splash daemon the current root is writable; no software installation.
plymouth-switch-root-initramfs.service: plymouth update-root-fs --new-root-dir changes the splash daemon's root reference during shutdown; no software installation.
plymouth-switch-root.service: plymouth update-root-fs --new-root-dir changes the splash daemon's root reference during boot; no software installation.
rpm-ostree-fix-shadow-mode.service: rpm-ostree fix-shadow-perms repairs local shadow-file permissions; does not stage or install a deployment.
selinux-check-proper-disable.service: Only emits a diagnostic about an inconsistent SELinux disable setting; no bootloader or software update.
ssh-host-keys-migration.service: Migrates existing local SSH host keys and records completion; does not install software.
systemd-boot-random-seed.service: systemd v259.9 bootctl random-seed refreshes boot entropy; it does not run bootctl update.
systemd-hwdb-update.service: systemd v259.9 systemd-hwdb update rebuilds the hardware database from installed definitions; no software installation.
systemd-journal-catalog-update.service: systemd v259.9 journalctl --update-catalog rebuilds the installed message catalog; no software installation.
systemd-mountfsd.service: systemd v259.9 units/systemd-mountfsd.service.in mounts disk images; update appears in a libseccomp comment, not an updater command.
systemd-sysusers.service: systemd v259.9 systemd-sysusers initializes local accounts from installed definitions; no software installation.
systemd-udevd.service: systemd v259.9 hardware-event daemon, not a package/driver installer; update matches are unit comments or ordering.
user@.service: systemd v259.9 units/user@.service.in starts a user service manager; upgrade appears in a reload comment. No software installation.
user@1000.service: The recovery administrator instance of the reviewed systemd v259.9 user@.service manager template; no software installation.
user@1001.service: The daily ares instance of the same reviewed systemd v259.9 user@.service manager template; no software installation.
unity-gtk-module.service: Sets local GTK module environment in the user manager; no software installation.
xdg-document-portal.service: xdg-document-portal exposes selected local documents to sandboxed applications; no package/Flatpak installation.
